introduction: Sessions can wear their own pixel characters, updates now show you what is new before you install them, and a full audit fixed a list of rare failures.

cards.title: Characters for your sessions
cards.summary: A session can wear its own pixel character in place of the Claude logo, so several sessions are easy to tell apart at a glance.
details: 46 original characters in four worlds: Animals, Elementals, Fantasy World and Cyber World.
The Claude logo stays the default. Nothing changes until you choose a character.

visual.caption: Eight of the 46, two from each world

cards.title: Pick one right in the notch
cards.summary: Click a session's Claude logo, or its character, to open a picker inside the notch. Your pick replaces the logo for that one session and survives restarts.
details: "Claude logo" switches a session back, and "Surprise me" draws a random character.

visual.caption: Each session keeps its own mark

cards.title: Automatic characters, per project
cards.summary: Turn on "Give sessions a character automatically" in Settings → Appearance and each new session gets its own. A project can have its own collection to draw from.
details: A character you picked by hand always stays, and changing a collection never changes a running session.

visual.caption: A project's collection: only these are handed out there

cards.title: See what's new before you update
cards.summary: Checking for updates now opens a walkthrough like this one for the new version. Nothing is downloaded until you click Update Now.
details: The notes travel with the update itself, so what you read is what gets installed.
You can reopen the notes for your installed version from Settings → General.

cards.title: "Allow All" says exactly what it covers
cards.summary: A line under the buttons names the rule you are granting, and Allow All is offered only when it covers no more than the card shows.

permission.caption: Allow All covers Bash(npm test) in this session

cards.title: Setup ends in your real notch
cards.summary: The demo tour that followed setup is gone. "See your notch" now opens the real notch on your own sessions, and the notch only ever lists real sessions.

cards.title: Failed turns are reported correctly
cards.summary: A finished session no longer turns "Failed" by itself, and a turn that really failed is no longer shown as done.

rows.title: api-server
rows.detail: Shown as done after an API error

rows.title: api-server
rows.detail: The turn ended in an API error

cards.title: Deny answers to a click only
cards.summary: With several permission cards open, pressing Escape could deny a card you were not looking at. Deny now always takes a click.

cards.title: Rare crashes and lost data
cards.summary: A second full audit of the app found and fixed several failures that were rare but real.
details: A model named just "claude" could crash the session list.
One unreadable history record no longer hides all of your history.
Prompts and tool results over 64 KB are no longer dropped.
The closed notch now follows one session instead of swapping between two.
